definitions.explanation: Physically dense or thick in texture, concentration, or distribution.
Used figuratively to describe experiences, relationships, or time that is rich in content or emotionally intense.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{森|もり}→森：02260_mori⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{濃密|のうみつ}な⟦{緑|みどり}→緑：00970_midori⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{包|つつ}まれている→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧。
examples.english: This forest is enveloped in dense greenery.

examples.english: Dense vegetation spreads throughout the tropical rainforest.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
Na-adjective. Used as {濃密|のうみつ}な + noun (modifier) or {濃密|のうみつ}だ (predicate).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {濃密|のうみつ}: dense and rich in quality or content, often with positive connotations
- ⟦{濃|こ}い→濃い：02344_koi⟧: thick, strong (more everyday, used for flavors, colors, etc.)
- ⟦{密|みつ}→密：03777_mitsu⟧: dense, close-packed (focuses on spatial closeness)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {濃密|のうみつ}な⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧: intense/rich time
- {濃密|のうみつ}な⟦{関係|かんけい}→関係：01298_kankei⟧: intimate relationship
- {濃密|のうみつ}な⟦{霧|きり}→霧：02200_kiri⟧: dense fog
- {濃密|のうみつ}な⟦{内容|ないよう}→内容：01482_naiyou⟧: rich content
